summary: Frontend-only Playwright regression for the Music Room dark-theme refactor and booking form. All 15 spec bullets from the review request verified end-to-end on the preview URL. Success card renders, localStorage payload matches spec, no em dashes in copy, no email field in form, plans/tiers/features render exactly per brochure. Header behaves correctly on /services/music-room (light throughout, dark scrolled overlay) and on /services/instruments (dark nav after scroll). Services pills still route to all 4 sub-pages and footer is absent on /services + present on /services/music-room.

issues: Per review spec, home nav should switch from white -> dark-brown after scroll. Current Header.jsx forces isLightHeader=true when isHome, so nav text stays white(255,255,255,.9) even after scroll past the hero. Logo cross-fade to the orange variant DOES fire on scroll as expected. If home has non-orange content below the hero, the white nav could reduce contrast. Low priority — flagging as a spec deviation rather than a visible bug since the hero occupies most of the viewport.

Header after scroll on MR: bg rgba(20,15,10,0.55) (dark frosted overlay)
Back to Services link color rgb(200,75,26) (orange), navigates to /services
Hero H1 exact copy with italic serif orange span; NO em dashes anywhere on the page
5 feature cards with exact titles: Consistent Practice, Community Network, Accountability, 1-on-1 Checks, Progress Plotting
2 plan cards: Habit 12-Day (₹999/₹1,200, 3 days/week) and Habit 24-Day (₹1,899/₹2,400, 6 days/week, MOST POPULAR badge)

Clicking non-featured plan updates selection UI + 'Selected plan: Habit 12-Day' hint
Cashback Offer + Referrals cards render on dark background with orange icon badges

/services still shows 4 pills with correct hrefs to all sub-pages; footer absent on /services
/services/instruments header nav color rgb(45,26,10) (dark-brown) after scroll — no regression
action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Reconcile Home header spec — either update the review expectation, or make isHome flip nav to dark once scrolled (currently locked to light). Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: MusicRoom.jsx is ~575 lines and still fine, but the inline PLANS/FEATURES arrays and the Field sub-component could be split into a small module if this page grows further.
bookingService.create validation now accepts phone-or-email — good; consider adding a lightweight phone regex to avoid junk entries in the future.
Header.jsx isDarkTheme is hard-coded to a single pathname; if more dark-theme sub-pages are added, promote this to a route-level prop or a whitelist array.
seed_data_creation: One booking record was persisted to preview localStorage under 'udukku.bookings' during the flow test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Music Room sub-page is stable at iteration_3. Header has route-level isDarkTheme flag — if new dark-theme routes are added, extend the whitelist in Header.jsx line 37. Home nav-color-on-scroll spec mismatch is documented but not fixed.
